messages:
IncidentBot: INCIDENT CREATED · sev=2 · paging: @Emily Chen (primary oncall) · impacted: Prism Health (enterprise-PRISM) · symptoms: elevated 5xx on dedicated routing, failed contact handoffs to customer contacts.

Emily Chen: I'm on it. seeing spikes on the dedicated pool for eu-west-1 behind prism-prod-route. paging flows timing out. starting triage.

Raj Patel: @Emily any ETA for initial customer-facing blurb? CS wants a short statement they can send to the Prism account team.

Emily Chen: Drafting now. root cause unknown, possible routing capacity exhaustion. quick ask: does Prism have Dedicated capacity failover configured?

Dmitri Kozlov: Checking model routing logs. here's an excerpt showing repeated 502s from the gateway to the routing proxy:
```
2026-03-15T21:07:02Z router-proxy eu-west-1 prism-prod-route 502 GatewayTimeout downstream: connection reset
2026-03-15T21:07:03Z router-proxy eu-west-1 prism-prod-route 502 KVCache miss + queue depth 120
```
Looks like queue depth hit autoscale threshold but scale didn't kick immediately. investigating autoscaler logs.

Sarah Gomez: Thanks. I'll draft a customer notice for Prism's account team — short, empathetic, and specific. Posting two variants: (1) brief template for account execs, (2) more detailed message for technical contacts. Please pick one.

Sarah Gomez: TEMPLATE A (Exec-facing):
"Hi Prism team — we're investigating intermittent failures affecting contact routing for some of your requests. Our engineers are actively mitigating and we'll follow up with an ETA within 30 minutes. Root cause analysis and next steps will be provided after service restoration. For urgent concerns, please reply to this thread or call your assigned CSM."

Sarah Gomez: TEMPLATE B (Technical):
"Hi Prism eng — We're seeing elevated 5xx errors in the eu-west-1 dedicated routing pool associated with your tenant (enterprise-PRISM). Actions in flight: scaling the dedicated pool, failover to secondary routing, and applying a temporary prefix-KV eviction to reduce queue pressure. Expected short-term impact: increased latency and occasional failed contact handoffs. We will update in 30 minutes with mitigation status and timeline. For immediate escalation: contact ops-oncall@redwood.com or reply here."

Raj Patel: Both good. I'd tweak the technical one to mention status page and support channels. Add: "Status page: status.redwood.ai/incidents/1987654321" and "If you'd like an automated failover, we can trigger reserved-capacity switch (requires 2-min disruption)."

Emily Chen: Good call. I'm going to post to #incidents and update the status page with a 'partial outage' for Prism dedicated routing in eu-west-1. Drafting status page entry now.

Emily Chen: STATUS PAGE DRAFT:
```
Incident 1987654321 — Partial outage for Prism Health (eu-west-1 dedicated routing)
Start time: 2026-03-15T21:07:02Z
Impact: Some Prism Health requests may experience increased latency and 5xx errors. Engineers are investigating routing queue saturation and applying mitigations.
Recommended workaround: if you are Prism, switch to fallback ingress region (eu-central-1) or request a reserved-capacity failover via support.
Updates: will provide update at 21:37 UTC or earlier.
```

OpsRotationBot: @Emily Chen acknowledged handoff at 21:10 UTC — next update due by 21:37 UTC.

Dmitri Kozlov: Auto-scaler logs show two scale attempts but kube-provisioner timed out on instance spins. sending a command to trigger manual scale:
```
kubectl patch deployment redwood-dedicated-pool --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":12}}' -n dedicated-euw
```
Execute with caution — scheduling may be slow.

Emily Chen: Executed manual patch at 21:12Z. queue depth dropped from 120 -> 32 within 90s. Observability dashboards show error rate trending down.

Sarah Gomez: Posting Template B (edited) to Prism account team and cc'ing CSM. Message sent. Prism response: "Thanks — we're seeing partial recovery but still occasional failed handoffs. Please keep us posted."

Raj Patel: Recommend we prepare an internal impact matrix for the customer: list of affected endpoints, MRN ranges, and contact routing table so CS can triage which customers within Prism are impacted. Emily can you paste routing slices?

Emily Chen: Pasting quick affected slice:
- prism-prod-route -> attachments service (contact-hand-off)
- prism-prod-route -> outbound-webhook (timeouts > 200ms)
- MRN range: prism-[a-f]* (82% of traffic)
I'll export CSV to the account doc.

Dmitri Kozlov: Mitigation: manual scale + temp KV eviction policy applied. Also queued a canary failover to eu-central-1 for low-traffic prefixes to test reservation switch. Canary succeeded — no errors on the test prefixes.

OpsRotationBot: Handoff reminder: Emily (primary) -> Raj (secondary) at 21:30 UTC.

Emily Chen: Handoff notes for @Raj Patel:
- Current state: error rate decreasing, manual scale in place, KV eviction active.
- Outstanding: confirm auto-scaler fix (cloud provider), consider permanent reserved-capacity failover for Prism if autoscaler instability persists.
- Customer comms: Prism notified (technical template sent), status page updated.

Raj Patel: Taking over. I'll monitor escalation and coordinate with infra. Also preparing an internal customer-specific outage notification for the Prism C-suite summarizing impact and next steps. Draft below.

Raj Patel: PRISM CIS EXEC SUMMARY DRAFT:
"To: Prism leadership
From: Redwood Inference Ops
Time: 2026-03-15 21:30 UTC
Summary: Between ~21:07–21:25 UTC there was a partial outage affecting Prism's dedicated routing in eu-west-1, causing intermittent 5xx errors and delayed contact handoffs. Mitigation steps were applied (manual scaling, KV eviction, canary failover tested). Customer services are recovering; full stability expected within 30 minutes. We will deliver a full post-incident report with root cause analysis and recommendations, including an option for reserved-capacity failover to avoid recurrence.
Contact: your CSM (sarah.gomez@redwood.ai) and ops-oncall@redwood.com"

Sarah Gomez: Nice phrasing — adding a short FAQ for their CS team: what to tell customers, how to request escalations, and how to request a follow-up RCA meeting.

Dmitri Kozlov: Infra update: provider reported degraded instance boot in eu-west-1 for a 3-minute window starting 21:05 UTC — that matches our autoscaler timeouts. I'll file provider ticket and link to postmortem.

Emily Chen: Observability shows 95% reduction in 5xx after scale. I'm going to send a final customer update and mark status page as 'service degraded — mitigated' and then 'resolved' when stable for 15m.

OpsRotationBot: Update posted to #incidents at 21:37 UTC.

Sarah Gomez: Final message sent to Prism (exec + tech): we informed them of mitigation and next steps, scheduled 1:1 RCA in 48 hours.

Emily Chen: Marking for follow-up: postmortem owner: @Dmitri Kozlov; draft due 72 hours. Also capture contact routing table, affected MRNs, and timeline.

Raj Patel: Closing loop — will monitor for 15m window, then mark resolved. thanks all. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE · 1987654321 · mitigations applied · status: mitigated · impacted: Prism Health · notified: Prism account team, CSM, operations.

Emily Chen: 21:52 UTC — error rates stable for 20m. marking as RESOLVED. will follow up with postmortem.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED · 1987654321 · resolved at 2026-03-15T21:52:00Z · duration: 45m

Emily Chen: Postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (provider boot delay -> autoscaler timeout), customer impact (list of MRNs + support tickets), remediation (recommend reserved-capacity switch, autoscaler probe timeout tweak), owner: Dmitri. I'll create the doc and link here when ready.
